## koreanpulse maintainer notes (do not edit)

We accept enhancement requests but the **PMF auditor** discipline applies: until we have ≥5 paid signups, new MCP tools are deferred. We log every request and revisit during the 30-day BETA decision matrix.

If your request is **time-sensitive for paying use** (Cloud customer hitting a real workflow gap), please mark with `[urgent]` in the title.
